Mark tag with double equal highlight style

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, HighlightStyle, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>Text with <mark>highlighted</mark> here.</p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(highlight_style=HighlightStyle("DoubleEqual"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
